What's your return and refund policy?
Happy to help. Here is a clear overview of how our returns and refunds work for orders placed directly with us:
Free UK returns: Returns are free within the UK.
Timeframe for returns: Return any item within 30 days of receipt in its original condition and we will refund the amount you paid for it.
Sale items: You have 14 days from receipt to register your return with our online returns partner, then a further 14 days to send the item back in its original condition.
Refund amount: Offers and discounts are applied per item. You keep any discount on items you keep, and returned items are refunded at the price you paid after the discount.
Refund method: Refunds are made to your original payment method. If your order has an outstanding pre‑order item, the cost of that item may be deducted from your refund, with the remaining balance refunded to your original payment method.
Items that cannot be refunded: Swimwear if the hygiene strip has been removed, and earrings if the internal packaging seal has been broken.
Exchanges: We do not offer exchanges. Simply return your item for a refund and place a new order online.
Our 365‑day quality guarantee
After the standard return window, you can return anything that does not meet our quality standards up to one year after your order arrived.
Faulty items returned within 6 months of receipt will be refunded. Returns made between 6 and 12 months from receipt will be credited to your account for the amount paid. Account credit has no expiry and can be used on any future order, including sale items. If you purchased with a discount or offer, we will adjust the refund accordingly.
For full details, please see our Returns and refunds page.
